name: Raging Thunder 2 Vita
author: MetalSyntax
description: Raging Thunder 2 is an arcade racing game originally released for Android (Polarbit Fuse engine, GLES 1.1). This port loads the unmodified librthunder2lite.so (armeabi) and re-implements the Android/Java layer it expects: lifecycle, EGL/GLES 1.1, touch/key/accelerometer input, audio mixing, file access and LiveArea, so the game runs natively on the Vita.
requirements:
- libshacccg.suprx
- kubridge.skprx
- Game Data Files: Android
